item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
Improvements

  • Pro: Steam connector errors name the cause and the error code instead of only saying the connector did not respond.
  • Pro: the app log, the diagnostics export and the bug report keep each failed connector call and the connector's recent crash reports.
  • Pro: read-only connector calls retry once after the connector quits.
  • Pro: Diagnostics re-runs checks that failed only because the connector was unavailable when you open the page again.

Bug Fixes

  • An extra file in the app bundle, such as a ._ file left by copying the app through an external drive, no longer makes every Steam connector or system wallpaper maintenance call fail.
  • Pro: finding SteamCMD automatically says why binding it failed.
